entities.name: Polyribonucleotide phosphorylase
observations: 703 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q97I45 from Clostridium acetobutylicum.
Catalyzes processive 3′→5′ phosphorolysis of single-stranded RNA, producing ribonucleoside 5′-diphosphates; EC 2.7.7.8.
Contains two RNase PH-related domains, a PNPase-associated domain, KH RNA-binding domain, and C-terminal S1 RNA-binding domain.
Curated homologs localize the protein to the cytoplasm/cytosol and associate it with mRNA degradation and RNA processing.

entities.name: mRNA degradation
observations: Polyribonucleotide phosphorylase participates in bacterial mRNA catabolism by processive 3′→5′ RNA phosphorolysis.
